- PDF tools: rotate pages, extract pages, and merge PDFs in the order you drag them into
- Bookmarks and form fields can be kept when you extract or merge PDF pages
- Rotate JPEG and PNG images without any loss of quality; photo details are kept
- Open phones, e-readers and cameras connected by USB, copy files to them and eject them safely (Linux)
- Make Ferrous Commander your default file manager in Settings, so folders and "Show in folder" in browsers open here (Linux)
